title: opencode-ntfy-with-questions configuration
description: Configuration for the opencode-ntfy-with-questions OpenCode plugin. Unknown properties are rejected. String values may reference environment variables ({env:NAME}) or files ({file:path}) that are expanded at load time; a reference must occupy the entire JSON string value.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this JSON Schema file.

enabled.description: Set to false to disable all notifications while keeping the plugin loaded.

events.description: Per-event notification toggles. Every event defaults to enabled.

session.idle.description: Notify when a session finishes its run and becomes idle.

session.error.description: Notify when a session reports an error.

permission.asked.description: Notify when opencode asks for a permission decision.

question.asked.description: Notify when the agent invokes the built-in question tool.

suppressSubagents.description: Suppress idle/error notifications for known subagent (child) sessions. Both flags default to true.

session.idle.description: Do not send session.idle notifications for child sessions.

session.error.description: Do not send session.error notifications for child sessions.

ntfy.description: ntfy server and topic settings. Required.

server.description: ntfy base URL. Must be http(s) with exactly ://, a DNS/IPv4 host, bracketed IPv6 or localhost, an optional canonical decimal port (0 or 1-65535, no leading zeroes) and an optional path prefix with percent-encoded characters allowed. Credentials, whitespace, query strings and fragments are rejected. A trailing slash is added when missing. Alternatively the entire string may be one {env:...}/{file:...} reference expanded at load time.

topic.description: ntfy topic name: 1-64 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 - _, or one full-value {env:...}/{file:...} reference expanded at load time.

token.description: Optional ntfy access token sent as an Authorization: Bearer header. Never logged. Either a plain literal without reference markers or one full-value {env:...}/{file:...} reference.

priority.description: Fixed notification priority for all events.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each ntfy HTTP request.
